svg.aria-label: The workout, on an animated phone, in six steps. The workout screen shows the top bar (minimise, timer pill, Finish), the Duration, Volume, Sets box, and the Bench press exercise with its table: Set, Previous, Kg, Reps, three sets whose previous values are 80 kg × 8, 80 kg × 8 and 80 kg × 7. Step 1: one tap on the tick validates the first set, 80 kg × 8; the row turns green, the volume rises to 640 kg and the counter to 1 set. Step 2: the rest timer starts on its own, 90 seconds by default, 60 at most after a warm-up set, never in the middle of a superset nor after the last set; the blue pill shows the time left. Step 3: one tap on the pill opens the timer full screen, a blue ring that empties, with the −10, +10 and Stop buttons; +10 adds ten seconds. Step 4: when the rest ends, the phone buzzes briefly at 3, 2 and 1 second, then longer with the end sound; in the background, a Rest over notification takes over. Step 5: the second set goes to 82.5 kg × 8 and exceeds the heaviest weight of earlier workouts, 80 kg: that is a gold medal; the row turns gold, the PR badge opens at the top of the screen and announces it, and the summary box gains a Records column. Step 6: the chevron minimises the workout into a Workout in progress bar sitting above the tabs, with the clock and the Resume and Discard buttons. Every action is written to the phone.

svg.text: One exercise, three sets: tick, rest, beat a record, minimise.
One tap on the tick: the row turns green, the volume and the set counter go up.
An empty field takes the “Previous” value; an empty set with no previous one is not validated.
The exercise’s timer starts on validation: 90 s by default, 60 s at most after a warm-up set.
It starts neither in the middle of a superset nor after the last set of the workout.
One tap on the pill opens the timer full screen: the blue ring empties with the time left.
“−10” and “+10” remove or add ten seconds; “Stop” ends the rest.
The phone buzzes briefly at 3, 2 and 1 second, then longer, with the end sound.
App in the background: a “Rest over” notification takes over.
82.5 kg × 8 exceeds the heaviest weight of earlier workouts (80 kg): that is a gold medal.
The row turns gold, the “PR” badge announces it. At 80 kg × 8, set 1 only equalled the best.
The chevron closes the screen without stopping the workout: a bar stays above the tabs.
It shows the clock, “Resume” and “Discard”; neither the current exercise nor the rest.
Every action is written to the phone: the workout in progress comes back as it was after the app is closed.
